resolutions.researcher_notes: current_ref gxsngc.com loads 200 but is an empty CMS placeholder article (no body, literal '新闻标题' title, date 0000-00-00) -- does not support Status=operating in any form; confirms prior deep-sweep audit finding. No web.archive.org snapshot exists (checked). Fresh Chinese search (南宁-扶绥天然气支线管道, 广西天然气支线管网 南宁 扶绥, 扶绥县 天然气管道 通气 投产, 南宁-扶绥天然气支线管道 2023 通气 投产 竣工) found NO news of a commissioning/start-of-operations event for a 'Nanning-Fusui' branch. DID surface the underlying project: an EIA report titled '广西天然气支线管网项目南宁-扶绥天然气支线管道工程 环境影响报告书（公示本）' (developer: 广西广投天然气管网有限公司; approval public notice dated 2018-07-09 on the Guangxi Ecology & Environment Dept site, sthjt.gxzf.gov.cn) whose search-engine-indexed specs (route Jiangnan District Nanning -> Fusui, 20km, 6.3MPa, D355.6mm, ~8.52e8 m3/y) match this row's Length/Diameter/Pressure/Capacity almost exactly -- strong indication the underlying pipeline is real and correctly specified. But BOTH the PDF (W020180627563782878724.pdf) and its approval-notice page (t3582974.shtml) on sthjt.gxzf.gov.cn ConnectTimeout on direct fetch AND via WebFetch (ECONNREFUSED), consistent with the brief's fgw.gxzf.gov.cn/gxzf.gov.cn geo-block pattern, and archive.org has no snapshot of either URL. Could not find any operational/status confirmation (2023 or otherwise) from a reachable source. UNRESOLVED, not a value disagreement.

Could not independently confirm ProposalYear/Month=2017-12. UNRESOLVED.

current_ref fgw.nanning.gov.cn -- ConnectionError (does not resolve at all, confirmed by prior deep-sweep audit via multiple DNS resolvers: SERVFAIL). No wayback snapshot. Search DID find a strong secondary lead: the 2018 EIA report for '南宁-扶绥天然气支线管道工程' (see Status unit notes) whose search-engine-indexed text states design annual capacity ~8.52x10^8 m3/y (=0.852 bcm/y), matching the recorded 0.85 bcm/y closely. However the only URLs for that EIA report (sthjt.gxzf.gov.cn PDF + approval-notice page) both ConnectTimeout/ECONNREFUSED (geo-blocked, same .gxzf.gov.cn pattern as the known-blocked fgw hosts) and have no archive.org snapshot, so I cannot cite a working URL. Also checked a 2022 Guangxi 'energy network' province-wide gas-pipeline project-tracking PDF (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn, reachable only via a wayback snapshot) -- it does NOT list a Nanning-Fusui line at all (it lists a different pipeline, 田东-德保-靖西支线, that happens to share the same 6.3MPa/D355.6mm spec, a common standard branch-pipe size in Guangxi -- not evidence for this segment). UNRESOLVED, not a value disagreement; the recorded value looks plausibly correct per the unreachable EIA source but is uncorroborated by any citable, verifiable URL.

The unreachable 2018 EIA report lead (see other units) indexes as routing from the West-to-East Gas Transmission Line II South Nanning-Baise branch's Wuxu input station in Jiangnan District, Nanning, through Jiangxi Town (Jiangnan District) and Longtou Township (Fusui County), to a newly-built Fusui branch output station -- consistent with the recorded Start=Nanning/Guangxi, End=Fusui/Chongzuo(prefecture)/Guangxi.
